system.description:
You sink into the bosom of the earth, diffusing half into spirit as the soil closes over you, there to sleep out the day mystically undisturbed.

You must be touching raw soil — never stone, wood, concrete or the like. Expend one Blood Trait and spend a full turn descending, taking only your clothing and small carried possessions with you. While melded you are protected completely from daylight, cannot be readily detected either physically or by spirits, and cannot move except to rise. If the soil is disrupted you are hurled back to the surface and cannot act during that first turn; if you rise of your own accord (which you may do at any time) you are fully aware and act normally.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
